title: Local-in-Time Existence of $L^1$ solutions to the Gravity Water Wave Kinetic Equation
summary: In this paper, we study the Cauchy problem for the four-wave kinetic equation describing the weak turbulence of gravity water waves. The mathematical challenges of this analysis stem primarily from two interrelated aspects: (1) the extreme algebraic complexity of the collision kernel, where controlling its growth in the highly non-local regime constitutes the primary analytical bottleneck, and (2) the construction of strong solutions under the resulting singular integral operators.
